visualCharacteristics: Dark hero with a white heading to the left of supporting copy and CTAs on desktop, followed by full-width media and an optional authored caption. Content stacks on smaller screens.
contentPattern: Authored image, H1/H2/H3 heading, supporting paragraphs, and standalone CTA links across one or more cells. Text accompanying a separate image cell becomes its caption.

options.name: split
options.description: Places copy beside media on desktop and stacks content before media on mobile. Supports optional Eyebrow, Heading, Content, Image and Offer rows.

options.name: balanced
options.description: Uses equal text and image widths on desktop. Combine with split: Hero Dark (Split, Balanced).

options.name: inset
options.description: Adds desktop copy padding. Combine with split: Hero Dark (Split, Inset).

usageDescription: Introduces an authored campaign with accessible CTA links and a responsive image; missing optional content is supported.
